integrity: The proof is analytic for every \(a,b,u_0>0\) and every truncation order. Finite computation only replays closed-form identities and selected finite sections; it is not used to infer the infinite-order or all-time statements.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the unshifted monomial Carleman embedding on the scalar family \(\dot u=-a u-bu^2\). It does not characterize all multidimensional dissipative systems, pivot-shifted embeddings, or other linearization strategies. The explicit order \(N>(R+3)/(R-1)\) is sufficient for loss of lifted dissipativity, not claimed minimal.
title: Sharp scalar \(R=1\) boundary for dissipative Carleman truncation
